query: We’re seeing weird behavior when users enter certain inputs during login—like the system starts processing massive amounts of data. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?

We found a weird crash when feeding a long string with special patterns into a text truncation feature. It seems to hang or slow down unexpectedly. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We found a weird redirect thing in the app—someone can make a link that sends users to any site they pick. Is this something we’ve seen before?
We’re rendering SVGs in HTML, and if they contain scripts, users can inject malicious code. Is this a known issue or just something we’ve seen before?

We found something strange—someone can place a malicious file in a temp folder and make the system run it instead of checking the normal paths. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We got a response from a server that crashes the client when we trigger it. It looks like someone can send a crafted reply to run any code. Is this a known issue?
We hit a weird crash with a malformed input file. It seems like the parser writes past the end of a buffer. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re passing a setting that disables host key checks in SSH. Someone could intercept connections and pretend to be the server. Is this a known issue or just a config we missed?
We found a weird case where logged-in users can change run details like dates or settings. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found something strange—when someone runs a command in a folder with a malicious .env file, it seems to let arbitrary code run. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing a route that lets anyone increment failcounters if they pass a resolver param but don’t exist. Is this a known issue or something we should patch?
We’re seeing some crashes under heavy load. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re logging sensitive data in logs. It’s showing up in info or error levels. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found a case where a temp file can be overwritten by a local attacker using a symlink. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We hit a read past the end of a buffer during image processing. It might be exposing memory contents. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We found something strange — if a page has hidden metadata, it seems like the system lets attackers write files to any location. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing logs get corrupted when users feed in long inputs. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found some endpoints that let anyone access data without logging in. Is this a known issue or could it be exploited?
We found a function that lets anyone access and upload files without logging in. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing requests that trigger GPU decode without limits. It feels like someone can start decoding videos on demand and hog the GPU. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re passing user input through a function that expands environment variables. It’s doing this even when it shouldn’t. Is this a known issue or could it leak data?
We found a race condition where an account key might be exposed to local attackers. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found something suspicious in a package—when it's imported, it runs arbitrary code without warning. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found a weird thing: anyone can delete anyone else in a group, even the person who should own it. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We can access any file on the server if someone can reach the dashboard. Is this a known issue or just something we’ve seen before?
We’re seeing sensitive data being exposed in some runtime output. Is this a known issue or could it be an actual vulnerability?
We’re seeing a crash when certain input shapes are passed. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We’re writing to a memory area meant to be read-only, and it’s crashing when the data type doesn’t match. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re storing a token file that anyone on the system can read. Is this a known issue or just a weird default?
We’re letting users attach any file or URL to a PDF, even when we’re supposed to block it. Is this a known issue or just a bug we’ve seen before?
We noticed something strange — users can make our system talk to internal or private networks. Is this a known issue or just a misconfiguration?
We’re seeing crashes when tiling big tensors. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re parsing XML and it’s letting users read local files. Is this a known issue or just something we’re missing?
We found something suspicious in a function that lets users input commands—someone could inject code and run it directly. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We found something strange on Windows—maybe a malicious file gets placed in a spot where users can run it, like in their path. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing a weird issue where some prebuilt packages include a version of a crypto thing that might be unsafe. Is this a known problem or just something we’ve seen before?
We’re seeing crashes when a null value is passed to a certain attribute. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found something suspicious in the auth flow—someone might be able to inject scripts into responses. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We found a weird redirect thing in the login flow. If someone crafts a URL with a parameter, they might send users to a bad site. Is this something we’ve seen before?
We’re seeing XSS in Firefox when users upload files. The content type header seems to be ignored sometimes. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re seeing crashes in a core component when handling large inputs. It feels like a memory issue—does anyone know if this has been seen before?
We got a weird request that reads files and hits internal endpoints. Seems like a bad XML thing. Is this something we’ve seen before?
We’re seeing a crash when processing big inputs in a script. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We’re redirecting users to a URL from a query param. If that param points to a bad site, could it let someone steal data or trick users? Has this been seen before?
We found something odd—some archives are slipping through the cracks during extraction, letting symlinks get written in. Is this a known issue or just a weird edge case?
We’re seeing a crash in the model worker when handling certain inputs. It looks like it’s looping forever and using up all the resources. Is this a known issue or something we’ve seen before?

We’re extracting files from archives, but the paths aren’t being checked. Could this be a known issue where someone could sneak in malicious files through a path? Any idea if this has been seen before?
We noticed someone logging in on one site and then accessing another site without permission using the same session. Is this a known issue or just a weird edge case?
We’re issuing ID tokens without checking the scope. Is this a known issue or could it let someone get more access than they should?
We found a weird upload issue—someone could upload a file with a tricked name that might run commands if the system ever uses that name in a handler. Is this something we’ve seen before?
We hit a crash in a core function when processing certain inputs. It happens during normal use, not on edge cases. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We noticed something strange—when insecure is set, cert checks just disappear. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We found something suspicious in the model loading code—something that lets bad data run locally. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We hit a crash when parsing a weird input file. It seems like we're accessing something that's not there. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We’re seeing sensitive data getting logged in some output. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing a PDF parsing issue where big fonts cause massive memory use. Is this a known problem or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing redirects that accept weird URLs with lots of backslashes. Is this a known issue or could it be abused?
We’re seeing users expose private details when viewing profiles. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?

We noticed federation traffic is going clear text over the network. Someone turned off secure connections but left it exposed to the internet. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?

We found a case where malicious SVG code can still be stored and served, even when scaled. It doesn’t trigger if it’s inside an image tag, but we’re not sure if it’s a known issue. Is this something we’ve seen before?
We’re accepting file uploads, but reading the whole file before checking size. Could that let bad files slip through? Has this been seen before?
We found a spot where users can inject scripts into a form field. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We found a weird case where an invite link can be reused across multiple accounts. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We got a request to execute user input directly in code. It doesn’t validate if it’s actually a number first. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found something suspicious in the rendering code—someone can inject scripts that run in users' browsers. Is this a known issue or could it be a real problem?
We noticed a case where empty locks don’t trigger checks. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We found a weird issue where someone could potentially fake a one-time code. It looks like it might let unauthorized users trick the system into thinking they’re legit. Is this a known problem?
We’re seeing a crash when writing large data — it seems like memory is overflowing. Has this been seen before?
We’re seeing requests that take way longer than normal. It looks like some range headers are causing a loop. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We found something strange — users can inject scripts into content that's then displayed to others. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?

We found something strange in a dependency—someone can now run arbitrary code on users' systems. It’s like a hidden door that lets bad actors take full control. Is this a known issue or something new?
We’re seeing something weird — accessing a hidden object through a string-related feature lets users peek at sensitive data. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found a weird case where someone with just read access can take over a dashboard. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We got a crafted file that fools the system into thinking it's valid, even though it's not. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?

We’re decoding JPEGs and shrinking the image size — but the buffer size calculation seems off. When scaling down, it looks like we’re allocating a buffer that might be too small. Is this a known issue?
We’re seeing requests that let people read or write files by using weird paths. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found a config setting that lets users run arbitrary code. If someone can edit that config, they might execute random Python commands. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re seeing crashes in a core component when processing large inputs. Does this happen in other setups or is it a known issue?
We’re logging raw user inputs passed to subcommands. If someone enters a secret there, it shows up in logs. Is this a known issue or just a bug?
We’re seeing guest users getting private details like notes or addresses from list pages. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found a loop that can keep running forever if someone controls a condition in it. It might make the system use up all the CPU. Is this a known issue or something we’ve seen before?
We’re seeing memory blowup on POST requests. Someone’s sending huge video frame counts—no auth—causing the server to use way more memory. Is this a known issue?
We’re seeing session data getting mixed between users under heavy load. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?

We’re loading user URLs in a real browser, but the validation only happens for the first request. All follow-up requests go through without checks—could that let someone access internal stuff? Is this a known issue?
We found something suspicious in the file handling—someone can browse folders they shouldn’t. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We found a way for users to access local services on the host machine. It only happens on certain setups with Docker or similar tools. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We noticed something strange in the debug feature—when users input data, it shows up directly in the output without filtering. Could this be a known issue where someone might steal sensitive info?
We found something weird — if the URL ends with words like "Authentication" or "ServerInfo", anyone can access all the backend features, even without logging in. Is this a known issue?
We detected something odd—when a key is provided and no SSH config exists, it’s automatically setting strict host key checking to off. Is this a known issue or just a side effect we’re missing?
We found something strange in the code—doing a specific action triggers a memory read past the end of a buffer. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We got a request from an untrusted source with a URL — it triggered a server request to an internal endpoint. Could this be a known issue?

We found a weird path traversal issue where input with 9x encoding can bypass safety checks. It keeps looping through unquote calls but stops early. Is this a known problem or just a bug in the current code?
We’re seeing a crash in a core function when handling certain inputs. It happens randomly under specific conditions. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We’re loading some config from the current directory during a command, and that path can be controlled by the user. Could this let someone run arbitrary code? Is this a known issue?
We’re seeing some weird memory access in a component—when certain inputs are fed, it reads data from unexpected places. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re letting users pick a file name, and if it has paths like ../ or starts with /, it can write to any folder. Is this a known issue or just a weird edge case?
We’re seeing weird ciphertexts that seem to leak user data and fool other users. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing raw passwords and SNMP keys in API responses. Is this a known issue or just a bug we’re missing?
We’re loading untrusted YAML data into a function and it’s letting arbitrary code run. Has this been seen before? Is this a known issue?
We found something strange in the cache logic—someone can craft a path to make the system serve the wrong cached response. Is this a known issue or just a weird edge case?
We found something weird — if users paste content with noscript tags, the editor runs malicious scripts. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re reading data and weights in parallel, but no check exists to ensure weights match data size. Could this let someone read past the end of memory? Is this a known issue?
We’re seeing a buffer overflow when processing certain image data. It happens during a specific mode of decoding. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found something suspicious in the user input handling—someone could store malicious scripts that run on other users' pages. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?

We’re seeing something strange — a common dependency has a serious issue with a core component. It’s being flagged as one of the worst flaws ever in that component. Is this known or is it something new?
We got a request that lets someone browse any folder on the server. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We got a crash when users pass zero to a filter. It divides by zero in C. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We noticed something strange in user management — an attacker could trick a user into performing actions they didn't intend. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We hit a crash when processing empty inputs. It seems like we're accessing data from empty things. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re seeing a crash when loading untrusted data. It seems like some inputs trigger massive memory use. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We found something strange—someone can upload a fake package to a server, and when a system pulls it, it runs malicious code. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We found something odd—when a cookie has no name, like just "=value", it's being treated as a real cookie. Is this a known issue or could it be exploited?
We got a profile upload that lets someone pick a folder path and delete or overwrite files in it. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re seeing some weird crashes when processing large inputs. It feels like someone could trigger a crash with the right input—does anyone else see this or is it known?
We’re letting users send URLs to our system, but we’re not checking if they’re safe. Someone could make the system hit internal services. Is this a known issue?
We’re loading some objects in the system, and it seems like anything trusted by the system can be rebuilt. Is this a known issue or just a weird edge case?
We’re seeing super long inputs that make the system hang. It feels like a regex loop. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We noticed users can accidentally trigger delete/reset actions just by visiting a page. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We noticed someone can inject line breaks in a URL. It might let them sneak extra requests. Is this a known issue or just a weird edge case?

We noticed something strange — when a user is allowed to target minions via a config, the system seems to accept any minion, even if no valid targets were meant. Is this a known issue or could it be a real problem?
We’re rendering file previews and seeing malicious scripts show up. Is this a known issue or just a regression we’ve seen before?
We found a spot where bad scripts could be injected into user content. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re redirecting users and normalizing the Location header, but it’s picking up the wrong hostname. Is this a known issue or could it be exploited?
We’re getting WebSocket connections from random clients. They’re making requests without being authenticated. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We found a path that lets someone read any file on the server when uploading. It doesn’t check if the path is safe. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re seeing crashes when processing segment sums — it seems like the code assumes IDs are sorted, but doesn’t validate that. Could this be a known issue?
We got a request to sort by a column that shouldn't be sortable. It's bypassing the allowed list. Is this a known issue or something we've seen before?
We’re seeing requests that take forever to process—like looping through tons of headers or one giant header. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re seeing users create files in a temp folder with a pattern like /tmp/a-thing-of-user. It lets someone on the system make things crash or maybe get higher access. Is this a known issue?

We found something strange in the file handling—someone might be able to access files outside the allowed folder by sending specific path inputs. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We can modify settings that shouldn’t be editable—like toggling a flag or changing a token—without being caught. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We copied symlinked files into our local cache during a build. It feels like we might be exposing something. Is this a known issue or just a weird behavior?
We found something suspicious—someone can peek at private data or skip login using a specific input. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re seeing a crash when someone tries to add a second entry with the same name. Is this a known issue or could it be an exploit?
We found a weird issue where someone can change file permissions by manipulating paths. Is this a known problem or could it be exploitable?
We’re getting crashes when inputs are controlled by someone. It looks like a division by zero. Is this a known issue or something we’ve seen before?
We noticed something strange in the product creation flow—someone might be able to inject scripts that run in users' browsers. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
We’re reading files from anywhere in the system when using inline mode, and sending their contents back through a chat flow. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We’re letting redirects go through without checking if they end up on a private network. Is this a known issue or just a weird edge case?
We’re seeing auth cookies being signed with static data. Someone might be able to grab the cookie and reuse it forever. Is this a known issue?
We hit a CHECK fail when processing non-scalar inputs. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We found something strange — if someone inputs a specific value, it lets them access files outside the expected folder. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We noticed someone with a basic access level can still make changes—like editing files—when they shouldn’t. Is this a known issue or something we’re missing?
We’re following redirects for any scheme, not just HTTP. Is this a known issue or could it be exploited?
We found a case where user input can be executed directly in the browser. Is this a known issue or something we should be worried about?
We found something strange — someone can write to any file in /tmp/ by using a symlink. Is this a known issue or could it be a real problem?
We found a weird race condition where an attacker could trigger a code execution right after a check. Is this something we’ve seen before?
We found a case where access control is skipped in some code. Is this a known issue or could it be exploitable?
We’re seeing a PDF text extraction issue where large offsets cause massive memory use. Is this a known problem or just a weird edge case?
We found something strange in the search dropdown—someone could inject code that runs in another user’s browser when they search. Is this a known issue or something we should worry about?
